paragraphs.text: I long to meet you for many reasons, that I may have the benefit of your advice in the matters I had in hand, and that on beholding you after a long interval I may have some comfort for your absence. But since both of us are prevented by the same reasons, you by the illness which has befallen you, and I by the malady of longer standing which has not yet left me, let us, if you will, each forgive the other, that both may free ourselves from blame.

latex.p0004: 我渴望与你会面，原因甚多：既可在所处理之事上受益于你的忠告，又能在久别之后见到你，以稍慰你缺席之苦。然而，我俩皆因相同缘由受阻——你因降临于你的疾病，我因缠绕已久仍未离去的病痛——若你同意，让我们彼此宽恕，好使双方皆可免于责难。
